basis: The earliest qualifying communication found was Weis Markets’ Q4 2023 results release. Its quarterly net sales table reports $1,212,975,000 for the 13 weeks ended December 30, 2023, versus $1,306,090,000 for the 14 weeks ended December 31, 2022. Reported consolidated sales fell 7.1% and were $27,810,500 below the $1,240,785,500 threshold. Both figures include fuel and use the fiscal quarters as reported.

coverage.detail: The February 27, 2023 release established the 14-week Q4 2022 comparison base. Knowing that the prior quarter contained an extra week did not establish a dollar ceiling for Q4 2023.
At the April 27, 2023 shareholder meeting, the CEO projected more than $160 million of 2023 capital spending. He gave no Q4 net sales forecast.
The August 7 Q2 release reported sales for the 13 and 26 weeks ended July 1. It supplied no numeric Q4 sales outlook.
The October 2 Form 8-K disclosed an amendment to the revolving credit agreement. It gave no Q4 sales figure.
The November 6 Q3 release reported sales growth of 0.8% for Q3 and 2.8% for the first 39 weeks. The CEO said results were in line with expectations but gave no numeric Q4 or full-year sales forecast.

The Q3 Form 10-Q reported 39-week consolidated net sales of $3,483,975,000. As a cross-check, subtracting that amount from the $4,696,950,000 annual actual published February 27 yields the exact Q4 figure.
Weis’s distribution archive lists its November 6 Q3 results, February 8 dividend of $0.34 per share, and February 27 Q4 results consecutively. The dividend announcement supplied no sales guidance.
The February 9 Form 8-K disclosed Harold Graber’s retirement and the reassignment of his duties. It contained no Q4 sales update.

Searches of issuer materials and dated public remarks between the Q3 and Q4 releases found no preliminary results, investor presentation, or management call giving a numeric upper bound for Q4 consolidated net sales.
Item 2.02 confirms that Weis released its fourth-quarter and fiscal-year results on February 27, 2024, and identifies the earnings release as Exhibit 99.1.
EDGAR records the Form 10-K filing on February 28, one day after the public results release.

publication_date_evidence: Exhibit 99.1 bears a February 27, 2024 dateline. Weis confirms that release date in Form 8-K Item 2.02, and its distribution archive timestamps the announcement at 5:13 p.m. ET that day.
